name: Electric Sky
blurb: A natural blue dye grown from engineered algae, used in food and on clothing, for brands including Wrangler and Hanes.

name: Patented photobioreactor
blurb: A patented reactor plus genetic engineering system for algae, deployed across a decentralized network of 83 farming partners producing 550 metric tons.

name: Patented spirulina beverage
blurb: The drink that started the Richmond Times-Dispatch headline: spirulina that didn't taste like a pond.

name: Shipping-container COVID testing lab
blurb: A robotic diagnostic facility built for 4,096 patients/day, funded with $100k raised in two weeks, taken to a CLIA director for an FDA EUA application.

name: Ultrasonic fast-aging rig
blurb: Ultrasound-driven flavor infusion that cuts 80% of the cost of aging spirits. Validated by analytical chemistry and by a lot of people tasting things.

name: Mycological masonry
blurb: A grown replacement for concrete, brick, ceramic and asphalt — installed, not poured.

name: Growing Edible Algae on the Moon
blurb: A crowdfunded experiment in lunar regolith simulant, because someone has to figure out lunch up there.

name: The Biopunk House
blurb: A quarterly accelerator and residency for 20 participants, attached to a BSL-1/2 lab raised on $100k.

name: Primordia Grants
blurb: $13,200 awarded to 7 projects around the world. Small money, unreasonable leverage.

name: One-handed tourniquet
blurb: Designed for the case where you only have one usable hand left.

name: Google Glass hands-free music app
blurb: A novel-interface experiment from the brief window when Glass existed.

name: Thermal / cut-resistance testing apparatus
blurb: Purpose-built instrumentation for characterizing hundreds of industrial garments.
